prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: one transparent food selection sticker for the Super Nutrition mobile app.
Primary request: a small compact group of four red raspberries with distinct delicate hollow drupelet texture, no other berries.
Style/medium: crisp photorealistic food product photograph with realistic texture and gentle white studio light. Match the existing app food stickers: natural colors, clean thin white die-cut outline tracing the complete food silhouette. Individual asset only, not a sheet.
Composition/framing: one compact recognizable food group centered on a square transparent canvas. Entire subject visible with around 10% clear padding on every side; fills about 75-80% of the canvas. It must read clearly at a small mobile icon size. For elongated vegetables use a diagonal arrangement.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha background, not checkerboard or solid background. Only the named food and its own natural stems/peel/leaves; no decorative herbs, other foods, table, plate, bowl, packaging, shadows beyond the silhouette, text, labels, logo, watermark, face, anthropomorphic features, checkmark, badge or UI. White outline follows only the silhouette; no colored backing. Preserve truthful characteristic shapes and colors.

visual_inspection.notes: Four red raspberries with delicate hollow drupelets, realistic texture and compact complete silhouette; thin white outline, no other berries, labels or UI.
